claims.claim: Firefly descent expands network width or depth by searching a functional neighborhood around the current network using a Taylor-based greedy selection rule.
The method targets accurate and resource-efficient models.
Firefly descent can be applied to continual learning scenarios.

open_questions: How does Firefly descent perform compared to existing neural architecture search methods in terms of accuracy and computational cost?
What are the limitations of the Taylor-based greedy selection rule when scaling to very large networks?
